independent_model_comparison.interpretation: Excluding the cc001 data artifact, the teacher is accurate across all domains (<=0.32/family). In deployment-relevant domains the ORIGINAL student is DISTILLATION-limited (errB ~= errA; student worse than teacher in bulk-amorphous/surfaces/liquid) or MIXED (SiOx-defect/vacancy). No domain is genuinely teacher-limited. This DIFFERS from the R1 6-cell 'teacher-limited' conclusion.
